description: Defines the QuicSpdyStreamBodyManager class responsible for managing request stream body data in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicSpdyStreamBodyManager
classes.description: Manages body fragments and byte counts for a request stream in QUIC, providing methods to process and access stream body data.

methods.name: OnNonBody
methods.description: Called when non-body data is received; returns bytes to mark as consumed.

methods.name: OnBody
methods.description: Adds received body data to internal fragments.

methods.name: OnBodyConsumed
methods.description: Marks a number of body bytes as consumed internally.

methods.name: PeekBody
methods.description: Prepares iovec structures to point to available body fragments.

methods.name: ReadBody
methods.description: Copies body data into provided iovec structures and updates consumption.
